functions.purpose: MSVCRT-style float-to-ASCII conversion (like _gcvt / _fcvt): normalizes the double via frexp/modf/floor, emits significant digits, optional decimal point and 'E' exponent, and handles inf/0. Clamps precision to [1,0x10] (default 0xf).
formulas: precision default = 0xf if param_5==0; capped: if param_5>0x10 then 0x10
requires buffer: param_5+5 <= bufsize(param_3) else emits 'ASCII conversion buffer too small'
exponent estimate: frexp(x,&e); e = (e*0x4d)>>8  (0x4d/0x100 ~= log10(2)=0.30078)
DAT_11cd9c80 = 10.0 (repeated *10 to scale mantissa); DAT_11de9968 = rounding 0.5 add-const
functions.notes: Stock C runtime numeric formatting. Not game logic. Stack canary DAT_11e11390.

functions.purpose: Integer/fixed-point to ASCII with an implied decimal at 5 digits from the right. Handles sign, magnitude limit 0x80000001, inserts '.' when integer part < 6 digits. MSVCRT internal helper.
formulas: requires bufsize(param_3) > 0xc
abs value must be <= 0x80000000 (local_8 < 0x80000001)
5 trailing digits treated as fractional; decimal point emitted when leading digit index (local_c) < 6
functions.notes: Stock runtime. Not game logic.

functions.purpose: libpng png_set_filter(): maps caller filter selection (Sub/Up/Avg/Paeth) into the internal filter mask byte at struct+0x13a and lazily allocates prev-row buffers (offsets 0x10c/0x110/0x114/0x118). Errors if adding Up/Average/Paeth after row processing started.
formulas: filter mask byte @ +0x13a: case1->0x10(Sub) case2->0x20(Up) case3->0x40(Avg) case4->0x80(Paeth) case0->8(None); default->raw param_4
if(*(+0x600)&4 && method==0x40) method=0; only method 0 (PNG) supported else 'Unknown custom filter method'
buffer alloc size = *(+0xf4)+1 via FUN_10025d00
functions.notes: Stock libpng. Struct is png_struct.

functions.purpose: libpng row-transform dispatcher: applies the enabled read transforms in order based on the transform flag bitfield at png_struct+0x74 (quantize, expand, RGB->gray, gray->RGB, alpha, bgr, swap, shift, packswap, invert, etc). Pure image decode.
formulas: transform flags read from *(+0x74); each bit gates one transform (0x1000 gray, 0x40000 alpha add, 0x600000 rgb<->gray, 0x40 quantize, etc)
final pixel_depth @ row+0xb = channels(+9) * bit_depth(+10); rowbytes = (pixel_depth<8)? (depth*width+7)>>3 : (depth>>3)*width
functions.notes: Stock libpng. Not game logic.

functions.purpose: libpng: frees old zlib output buffer (+0xb0), stores new size (+0xb4), reallocates buffer, resets zstream next_out/avail_out pointers (+0x84/+0x88/+0x7c).
functions.notes: Stock libpng/zlib plumbing.

functions.purpose: Runs a zlib inflate loop over a compressed PNG chunk datastream, copying up to param_5 bytes into output buffer param_4. Reports zlib errors (buffer/data/incomplete) via png_error.
formulas: inflate ret: 1=stream end ok; 0=continue; -5 buffer error; -3 data error; else incomplete
copies min(avail_out, remaining_want) each pass via memcpy
functions.notes: Stock libpng+zlib.

functions.purpose: libpng writes the sCAL chunk (physical scale): assembles unit byte + two null-terminated ASCII numbers into a <=64-byte buffer and calls png_write_chunk with tag 0x7343414c ('sCAL').
formulas: total = strlen(width)+2+strlen(height); must be < 0x41 (64) else 'Can't write sCAL (buffer too small)'
chunk fourcc = 0x7343414c
functions.notes: Stock libpng.

functions.purpose: Tencent PAL (platform abstraction) tfile.c: reads an entire file into a newly calloc'd, null-terminated buffer. Returns size via out params. Asserts both out pointers non-null.
formulas: size = FUN_1004be50(handle); alloc calloc(1, size+1); returns -1 on error, 0 on success/empty
functions.notes: Tencent PAL library (lib_src/pal/tfile.c). Infra, both client/server.

functions.purpose: tconnd tcltapi client-connection send: writes a length-prefixed package via the low-level socket send (FUN_10049b90), logs success/failure with errno. Sets handle error code (field[1]) 4=bad-arg, 1=send-fail.
formulas: returns 0 on full send (iRet==len), -1 otherwise; handle->errcode field[1]=4(bad param)/1(send error)
functions.notes: Tencent tconnd network API (tcltapi.c). Transport layer plumbing.

functions.purpose: tconnd: extracts one complete package from the recv ring buffer. Reads a big-endian package-length header (header width 1/2/4/8 bytes at buf+0x30, and a second optional length field at +0x38), compacts buffer if incomplete, else memcpy's the full package out.
formulas: header field width selects endian-swap: 2->bswap16, 4->bswap32, 8->bswap64 (via __aullshr/__allshl), else raw byte
pkglen = local_8 + local_c (two length fields at offsets +0x30 and +0x38)
returns 1 when full package copied, 0 when need more data
functions.notes: Tencent tconnd. Big-endian length framing. Transport plumbing.

functions.purpose: tconnd receive: tries to parse a buffered package (FUN_1004fad0); if none, recv()s more data into buffer (respecting free space = field[7]-field[8]-field[9]) then re-parses. Logs no-space/recv-error/recv-data.
formulas: free space = recvbuff(field[7]) - field[8] - leftdata(field[9]); if<1 errcode=3(no space)
recv dest = buf(field[6]) + field[8] + field[9]; on data field[9]+=n
functions.notes: Tencent tconnd. Transport plumbing.

functions.purpose: Identical structure to RecvPackage (0x100502a0) but uses parser FUN_100506b0 (a different framing variant). tconnd receive + reparse loop.
formulas: same free-space and offset math as FUN_100502a0
functions.notes: Tencent tconnd. Transport plumbing; duplicate of 0x100502a0 with alternate parser.

functions.purpose: TDR (Tencent Data Representation) metalib deserializer core: iterates struct entries (0xb4-byte descriptors starting at meta+0xb8), resolves array refer-counts, validates refer value in [0,array_count], and copies/decodes each field into the host buffer honoring version cutoff. Generic serialization engine.
formulas: entry stride = idx*0xb4 + 0xb8 + meta base
refer-count width at entry+0x58: 2->u16, 4->i32(sign-extend), 8->i64, else u8
error 0x82010403 invalid refer value; 0x82010407 buffer not enough; error mask bit 0x80000000
inline string copy loop when size<=0x40 else memcpy
functions.notes: TDR runtime. Generic; not skill-specific but underlies all struct decode.

functions.purpose: TDR export entry point (data/struct -> XML or host-text into a buffer). Validates meta/xml/host pointers, clamps cutoff version to [baseVersion, meta.maxVersion], dispatches to output mode 1/3/other (FUN_10066d50 / FUN_10069c70 / FUN_10066510).
formulas: cutoff = (param_4==0 || param_4>meta.maxVer(+0xc)) ? meta.maxVer : param_4
reject if cutoff < baseVersion(meta+8): error 0x82010401
param invalid: 0x82010468
functions.notes: TDR runtime export. Plumbing.

functions.purpose: TDR export variant writing to a FILE* (a_fpXml). Same validation/cutoff dispatch as 0x1006a610.
formulas: same cutoff/version checks; errors 0x82010468 / 0x82010401
functions.notes: TDR runtime export. Plumbing.

functions.purpose: TDR export to a named file: fopen(path,'w'), writes XML prolog with encoding, dispatches by mode, fclose. Same version validation.
formulas: writes '<?xml version="1.0" encoding=%s standalone="yes" ?>'; error 0x82010446 on open fail
functions.notes: TDR runtime export. Plumbing.

functions.purpose: TDR export via an IOWrap descriptor struct (chooses file-name / FILE* / memory-buffer output source, and mode field). Validates the wrap fields and dispatches.
formulas: IOWrap layout: [0]=meta [1]=fileName [2]=FILE* [3]=buf [4]=buflen [5]=host.buf [6]=host.len [7]=cutoffVer [8]=mode [9]=arg
functions.notes: TDR runtime export. Plumbing.

functions.purpose: TDR import (XML text buffer -> host struct). Builds an xml_parser_tree, finds root, then decodes into host via FUN_1006dff0 respecting cutoff version. Reverse of 0x1006a610.
formulas: cutoff default 0x7fffffff when 0; reject cutoff<baseVer -> -0x7dfefbff; no-root -> -0x7dfefbf5; param err -0x7dfefb98
functions.notes: TDR runtime import. Plumbing.

functions.purpose: TDR import from a FILE* (parses xml tree via FUN_10070300). Same decode/version flow as 0x1006e120.
formulas: same error codes -0x7dfefbff / -0x7dfefbf5 / -0x7dfefb98
functions.notes: TDR runtime import. Plumbing.

functions.purpose: TDR import from a named file (parses via FUN_10070410). Same decode/version flow as 0x1006e120.
formulas: same error codes as sibling importers

functions.purpose: Tencent PAL tipc.c: converts a filesystem path into an IPC-safe name via GetShortPathNameA, then replaces backslashes with '_' and lowercases everything. Optional prefix param_4.
